四级汇总词汇 · 01英文原文

The Key to the Dry Room

干燥房间的钥匙 · 645 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1After years of renting an apartment, Lin's grandmother took a lease on a cottage. Its rent included a furnished room, some furniture, and a garage. Upstairs lodging was unfurnished. She had slept at a homely inn since her bedroom grew damp. The inn had an elevator and a canteen. She missed her cozy room. The inn could not offer the luxury of a familiar bed. At checkout the cashier helped load her wallet and belongings onto a cart. Lin wanted to check the vacant cottage before the removal truck arrived.

2A pensioner had rung the doorbell just as they reached the doorstep. He had been the cottage's last occupant and still kept a second-hand bookcase in the hallway. They untied a cord and carried it upright down the staircase. Moldy newspaper, a stocking, and a schoolbag fell from behind it. The dim, stuffy corner looked untidy beside the spotless bookshelf. His hands began to tremble as he pointed out a stain. He had opened the balcony door every night he slept there. Otherwise the air felt damp by morning. Lin stopped the removal driver from unloading their bedding.

3They began with the household appliances. Lin opened the freezer to defrost it and found the tray dry. She checked the dishwasher, then put a bucket under a dripping faucet. In the laundry closet the washing machine stood close to the dryer. Its drain hose was loose. Lin unplugged the washer and used a screwdriver to undo the back panel. A screw had pierced the hose. The plumber had left the machine ready to use, but nobody had tested it with a full load.

4Lin shook out a dusty rug and found a wet line beneath the clutter. It ran from the laundry cabinet toward a closet where a mattress, a pillow, and a rolled duvet stood against the wall. A bedsheet had soaked up the last spill. Turning up the thermostat would be useless. Lin moved a bedside dresser sideways, emptied a messy drawer, and fetched a dustpan, broom, and rubber pad. A box marked "cellar" held a cracked jug. She left it by the stove so she could discard it later.

5The landlady wanted to wipe the marks with bleach. Lin replaced the hose first. A wash with detergent showed the joint was watertight. Behind the dryer a pad of carpet was still wet. The plumber opened the vent and checked the bathroom. A loose toilet seal had made the small lavatory damp. The landlady noted both repairs on a clipboard. Cleaning would be tedious if another leak went unnoticed. They delayed occupancy until the rooms felt dry.

6While they waited, Lin sorted a sack from the old apartment. It held a saucepan, a jug, cutlery, two chopsticks, a napkin, and a toy her grandparent had kept for years. An old typewriter was tucked under an apron. The takeout cartons and broken vacuum went out with the trash. A kitchen cabinet could hold a plate, and a corner of the garage could take the ironing board. Her grandmother was homesick for the old place, so Lin put the toy beside a cushion on the couch and hung a familiar photograph over the fireplace.

7The next day a fresh bedsheet stayed dry. Lin used a stapler to attach the repair record to the rental agreement. The landlady checked the chore list and gave them a spare doorknob. Grandma slipped on her comfy slippers and chose the spacious room near the empty attic. A coat hook would come in handy when she hung her dressing gown after a bath. While Lin began to unpack, her grandmother checked the cabinet they had decorated and opened the balcony door to brighten the room. She wiped the doormat, switched off the toaster, and handed Lin the other key. The girl who helped her move would always have a bed there.

四级汇总词汇 · 01中文译文

干燥房间的钥匙

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1租了多年公寓后，林的祖母租下一座小屋。租金包括楼下一间带家具的房间和车库，楼上的房间则是空的。原来的卧室受潮后，她一直住在一家有家常气息的小旅店。那里有电梯和食堂，她还是想念自己舒适的小房间，尤其是那张睡惯了的床。退房时，收银员帮她把随身物品连同钱包放上推车。林想在搬家卡车到之前，先检查这座空了许久的小屋。

2她们刚到门阶，一位退休老人正好按响门铃。他是这里上一位住户，还在过道里留着一只二手书柜。他们解开绳子，把柜子竖着抬下楼。发霉的报纸、一只长袜和一个书包从柜子后面掉出来。书架一尘不染，后面的角落却昏暗、闷热又凌乱。老人指给她们看一块水渍，手微微发抖。他说，当初每晚都得开着楼上的阳台门，否则早晨空气很潮。林赶紧请司机先别卸下被褥。

3她们先查家电。林打开冰柜准备除霜，发现接水盘是干的。她检查洗碗机，又在滴水的水龙头下放了只桶。洗衣柜里，洗衣机紧挨着烘干机，排水软管有些松。林拔掉插头，用螺丝刀拆开后盖。一颗螺丝扎穿了软管。水管工离开时机器看似能用，却没人装满衣物试洗一次。

4林抖开一张落灰的小地毯，发现杂物底下有一道湿痕，从洗衣柜一直延伸到壁橱。橱里靠墙立着床垫、枕头和卷起的羽绒被，一条床单吸掉了上次流出的水。调高恒温器也没用。林把床边柜侧着挪开，腾空凌乱的抽屉，又取来簸箕、扫帚和橡胶垫。一个标着“地窖”的箱子里装着开裂的水壶。她把它放到炉子旁，留待稍后处理。

5女房东想用漂白剂擦掉水渍。林先换掉软管。加了洗涤剂试洗一遍，接头没有渗水。烘干机后的一片地毯仍是湿的。水管工打开通风口，又检查卫生间，发现松动的马桶密封圈也让小盥洗室受了潮。房东把两项维修记在夹板上。要是再漏一次才发现，清理起来会很麻烦。于是她们等到房间干了才入住。

6等待时，林整理从旧公寓带来的一只袋子。里面有炖锅、水壶、餐具、两根筷子、一张餐巾，还有祖母保存多年的玩具。围裙底下塞着一台旧打字机。外卖盒和坏掉的吸尘器当垃圾扔掉。厨房柜能放盘子，车库角落也能收下熨衣板。祖母想念旧家，林便把玩具摆到沙发靠垫边，又在壁炉上方挂起一张熟悉的照片。

7第二天，新铺的床单一直是干的。林用订书机把维修记录订到租约上。房东核对完清单，留下一只备用门把手。祖母穿上舒服的拖鞋，选了空阁楼旁那间宽敞的屋子。洗澡后，门上的挂钩正好可以挂浴袍。林开始拆包时，祖母看了看刚布置好的柜子，打开阳台门，让房间亮起来。她擦了门垫，关掉烤面包机，把另一把钥匙递给林。帮她搬家的姑娘，以后来这里总有张床可以睡。
